content.value:
cogtan — CATAN (Klaus Teuber, base game), a 4-player resource-race benchmark.

- The island: 19 hexes (4 forest, 4 pasture, 4 fields, 3 hills, 3 mountains, 1 desert), number tokens 2-12,
  9 harbors. Settlements on intersections collect 1 resource (cities 2) when their hex's number is rolled.
- Costs: road = brick+lumber; settlement = brick+lumber+grain+wool (distance rule + must connect to your road);
  city = 3 ore + 2 grain; development card = ore+grain+wool.
- A rolled 7: hands over 7 discard half; the roller moves the robber (blocks a hex) and steals a random card.
- Development cards (25): 14 knights (move the robber; 3+ = Largest Army +2 VP), 2 Road Building, 2 Year of
  Plenty, 2 Monopoly, 5 hidden Victory Points. One per turn, never the turn it was bought.
- Longest Road (5+ segments) +2 VP, transfers only when strictly beaten; a settlement can break a road.
- Trade with the bank at 4:1 (3:1 / 2:1 with harbors) or offer directed trades to opponents.
- Resource inventories are OPEN (every seat sees every hand); held development cards are the hidden information.
- First to 10 victory points ON THEIR OWN TURN wins. Score = final VP.

global.value:
Read-only spectator feed: the @cogweb/core ServerMessage stream the live console and
replay viewer render (snapshot / event / status / lobby / reset frames). Players
settle a 19-hex island: roll for resource production, build roads/settlements/
cities, buy development cards, trade, and race to 10 victory points. The
saved replay is { protocol:"cogweb.replay.v1", frames: ServerMessage[] }.
Spectators send nothing.

game.description: A four-player CATAN (Settlers of Catan) benchmark: agents draft starting settlements, manage stochastic resource production, negotiate trades, time the robber, and race to 10 victory points.

seed.description: Optional deterministic episode seed. Omit it for a fresh random board per episode (the secure league default: the board, dev-card deck, and every die roll are pure functions of the seed, so a pinned seed published here would let a player read the deck and every future roll).

tokens.description: Per-seat auth tokens injected by the runner; length is the seat count.

pace_ms.description: Minimum ms between automated decisions, for live viewing.

players.description: Per-seat player display names (seat order). The platform injects the real policy/player names here; the host labels each seat with them so replays and the live roster show real names instead of the engine defaults.

num_agents.description: Seat count for the episode. The league commissioner reads this from the variant game_config to size a Competition round; absent, it mis-sizes the episode to the entrant count and never dispatches. Always the fixed seat count.

act_timeout_seconds.description: Per-decision budget before the scripted fallback takes the turn.

time_initial_seconds.description: Fischer clock: each player's initial thinking bank in seconds (default 5). See time_per_turn_seconds.

time_per_turn_seconds.description: Fischer clock: seconds CREDITED to a player's bank at the start of each of its turns (its setup/preroll decision; default 5). Unused time banks for future turns. An empty bank degrades the seat to random legal moves until the next turn's credit.

player_connect_timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for all players to connect before starting anyway.

scores.description: Each seat's final victory points (hidden VP cards revealed), in seat order.

winner.description: The seat with the most victory points.

player.name: cogtan Scripted Baseline
player.description: Deterministic no-LLM baseline (best-pip setup spots, city > settlement > road builds, greedy discards, a leader-seeking robber). Certifies the contract offline.

player.name: cogtan LLM Baseline
player.description: A Bedrock-driven policy that plays the seat through the game's autopilot (system prompt + per-turn tool).

variants.name: Standard (4 players)
variants.description: A fresh random four-player island each episode (no fixed seed).

commissioner.name: cogtan Commissioner
commissioner.description: The stock ruleset_strategy commissioner with cogtan's config baked in: Competition schedules from a single champion, filling empty seats by duplicating the baseline, so a sparsely-entered league still plays. See coworld/commissioner/ in the source tree.
